Advantages

University of Kyiv

Cultural Diversity

Studying at an international university provides the opportunity to meet people from different countries and cultures.

Global Opportunities

Universities often collaborate with international organizations, opening doors to internships and jobs abroad.

Access to Resources

University offer a wide range of academic and professional resources, such as libraries, laboratories, and career centers.

About University of Kyiv

Kyiv University is a modern educational institution that provides high-quality higher education. The university enjoys a well-deserved reputation as one of the leading universities not only in Ukraine but also in Europe. This is due to the high level of student training, the wide selection of relevant and in-demand specializations, and the excellent career opportunities that await graduates. Our degrees are recognized internationally, enabling graduates to build successful careers both in Ukraine and abroad.

We place special emphasis on developing academic programs that follow international standards and incorporate the best practices from global education. A key aspect of our approach is our participation in international initiatives such as the TEMPUS programs and the Visegrad Fund, allowing us to continually improve the quality of education and integrate the latest innovations into our system. We train highly qualified specialists who become recognized experts and sought-after professionals in both the Ukrainian and global job markets.

The university warmly welcomes international students, offering them the opportunity to become part of a dynamic and innovative academic environment. Read more

Admission procces

Applying to university is a significant step in your life, opening up new horizons and opportunities for growth. This process can be exciting, but with the right approach and preparation, you can navigate it successfully. We are here to support you every step of the way on this exciting journey. Read more

01Step

Program Selection

Choose the program and field of study that interests you by exploring the options available on the university's website.

02Step

Document Submission

Gather all required documents, such as your diploma, transcripts, recommendation letters, and application form.

03Step

final stage

Complete any required entrance exams or interviews as required. Then pay the tuition fee and received an acceptance notification.
